snippet.title: Begraved - New Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
We are Grip Jaw, working on our indie game BEGRAVED! Explore cursed crypts & forbidden places in a medieval, first-person, co-op dungeon game coming to Steam Early Access https://steam.pm/app/4113160

Q: When is Begraved releasing?
A: We are currently targeting late 2026, originally we planned early access launch early 2026 but have decided to take more time and deliver a full game.

Q: Who is making Begraved?
A: Begraved is being developed by Grip Jaw, a small independent team of four. While three of the developers work at Irongate on Valheim during the day, Begraved is a passion project created in the evenings and on weekends, together with a dedicated community manager. Valheim's development is not affected in any way and both games are completely separate. For more info see our Discord or Steam FAQ's

Q: How much will it cost?
A: Similar to other "Lethal Likes"

Want more info join our Discord https://discord.gg/begraved
